meaning:
ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ
(ἅλς, the sea) [in LXX for דָּג, דַּוָּג ;]
a fisherman: Mat.4:18, 19, Mrk.1:16, 17, Luk.5:2
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
